dct_description_sm: Contained within the National Parks, 1961 to 1994, Atlas of Canada series, is a map that shows Banff, Kootenay and Yoho National Parks. This large, bilingual map shows general reference data for the general area, notably showing glacial features. All parts of the map area contain topographic data (with the contour interval being 200 metres). Many peaks are named, and often have their elevations shown (with data in metres). Shaded relief is used on the map. The map contains data of particular interest to park visitors such as detail about trails and more names in popular parts of the parks.
dct_title_s: Banff, Kootenay and Yoho National Parks
